name: io.github.ianderso/us-places-mcp
title: US Places, Then
description: US places then: county on a date, PLSS land, GNIS names, old topo maps, post offices.

environmentVariables.name: US_PLACES_GNIS_URL
environmentVariables.description: USGS's GNIS map service (The National Map).

environmentVariables.name: US_PLACES_GNIS_ARCHIVE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where USGS keeps the August 2021 GNIS state files.

environmentVariables.name: US_PLACES_TNM_URL
environmentVariables.description: The National Map's TNM Access products API.

environmentVariables.name: US_PLACES_DATAVERSE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Harvard Dataverse, which holds the US post offices dataset.

environmentVariables.name: US_PLACES_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache and the downloaded datasets.

environmentVariables.name: US_PLACES_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so the services can reach whoever runs the server.
